title: Zesty Gooey Ukrainian Pancakes
description: A solo dinner dish featuring rice flour pancakes with a funky and gooey twist, made with sauteed ingredients and no added sugar, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together rice flour, eggs, milk, and melted butter until smooth and free of lumps.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil to the pan.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Loosen the pancake with a spatula and flip it over, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the other side is lightly browned.
In a separate pan, saute the sliced green onions and dried dill in a small amount of oil until softened.
Add the crumbled feta cheese to the pan and stir until well combined with the green onion mixture.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked pancake on a plate and top with a spoonful of the sauteed green onion and feta cheese mixture.
Drizzle the top of the pancake with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkle with garlic powder and salt.
Repeat the process with the remaining batter and filling ingredients.
